Travel paperwork explained this week
This article covers the basics for guests
Topic: travel paperwork for companion animals

If you are flying with a pet, paperwork is part of the trip from the first booking step to pickup. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk checks the forms, then the welfare coordinator looks over comfort needs so the animal can travel in a steady way.

For large dog travel, <<FACT F075>> Please keep the needed papers ready before you head to the airport, because missing paperwork can slow the handoff and cause extra stress for you and your animal. <<FACT F081>> Bring the health certificate, travel record, and any other documents listed on your booking notes.

If something looks unclear, send it in early and let the desk review it. That gives the team a chance to spot gaps and fix them before check-in. The cabin team also keeps watch during flight and passes along updates if a concern comes up.

If you are traveling with a nervous pet, say so when you book and again at check-in. The team can note comfort needs, bedding requests, and handling concerns. If you are moving with more than one animal, make sure each set of papers is matched to the right pet.

For the smoothest trip, keep copies with you and keep the originals easy to reach. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
